name: Deuce n' Domino
notes: Lost a number-one-contenders match to Cade & Murdoch on WAR #7 blamed on a lack of communication, then repeatedly interfered on the champions' own behalf at Summer Party.
caption: A tag pairing that lost its own number-one-contenders match on WAR #7, then helped the Tag Team Champions retain at Summer Party.

name: Lance Cade & Trevor Murdoch
notes: Beat Deuce n' Domino on WAR #7 to earn a Tag Team Championship match, then lost that match to London & Kendrick at Summer Party after Deuce n' Domino's own interference backfired on them.
caption: WAR's own number-one contenders for the Tag Team Championship, who came up short at Summer Party.

name: Paul London & Brian Kendrick
notes: Retained the promotion's own UWF Tag Team Championship against Cade & Murdoch at Summer Party, with unsolicited help from Deuce n' Domino.
caption: The promotion's own UWF Tag Team Champions at Summer Party.

name: John Morrison & The Miz
notes: Billed as having won the Sacrifice Tag Team Championship at the promotion's own New Years Party (January 2009, not independently captured); retained against Jesse & Festus on Sacrifice #1 with an assist from Randy Orton.
caption: Sacrifice's own Tag Team Champions as of its own first show.

name: Jesse & Festus
notes: Lost a Sacrifice Tag Team Championship match to John Morrison & The Miz on Sacrifice #1 after Randy Orton's interference, then earned a TLC Tornado tag rematch for the following week.
caption: A tag pairing that came up short against Sacrifice's own Tag Team Champions on the brand's first show.
